title: UP BOARD CLASS 5 — English | Direct Indirect Speech
description: Subject-wise test on Direct Indirect Speech (English) for UP BOARD CLASS 5. 40Q.
subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: Ram said, “I am reading a book.” This sentence in indirect speech will be:

options.text: Ram said that I am reading a book.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'I' should change to 'he' and 'am reading' should change to 'was reading'.

options.text: Ram said that he was reading a book.
options.explanation: Correct because 'I' changes to 'he' and 'am reading' changes to 'was reading'.

options.text: Ram said that he is reading a book.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'am reading' should change to 'was reading'.

options.text: Ram said that I was reading a book.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'I' should change to 'he'.

questions.explanation: In indirect speech, the present continuous tense “am reading” changes to past continuous “was reading.” The pronoun “I” changes to “he” to match the subject Ram.
questions.subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: She said, “I have finished my homework.” Which of the following is the correct indirect speech?

options.text: She said that she has finished her homework.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'have finished' should change to 'had finished'.

options.text: She said that she had finished her homework.
options.explanation: Correct because 'have finished' changes to 'had finished'.

options.text: She said that she was finishing her homework.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'have finished' does not change to 'was finishing'.

options.text: She said that I had finished my homework.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'I' should change to 'she'.

questions.explanation: The present perfect tense “have finished” changes to past perfect “had finished” in indirect speech.
questions.subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: The teacher said to the students, “Do not make noise.” Choose the correct indirect speech form:

options.text: The teacher told the students not to make noise.
options.explanation: Correct because the command is converted to infinitive form with 'not to'.

options.text: The teacher told the students to not make noise.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'not' should be placed before 'to'.

options.text: The teacher told the students that they should not make noise.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the command is not converted to infinitive form.

options.text: The teacher said the students not to make noise.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'told' is used instead of 'said' for indirect commands.

questions.explanation: Commands in direct speech are converted to infinitive form in indirect speech using “told” or “asked” followed by “not to.”
questions.subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: Assertion (A): In indirect speech, the word “yesterday” changes to “the previous day.” Reason (R): Because time expressions shift backward in indirect speech.

options.text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.explanation: Correct because both assertion and reason are true and the reason explains the assertion.

options.text: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the reason correctly explains the assertion.

options.text: A is true but R is false.
options.explanation: Incorrect because both assertion and reason are true.

options.text: A is false but R is true.
options.explanation: Incorrect because both assertion and reason are true.

questions.explanation: “Yesterday” correctly changes to “the previous day” and the reason correctly explains why time expressions shift in indirect speech.
questions.subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: He said, “Where is the library?” The correct indirect speech is:

options.text: He asked where the library is.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'is' should change to 'was'.

options.text: He asked where the library was.
options.explanation: Correct because 'is' changes to 'was'.

options.text: He asked where was the library.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the subject-verb order is incorrect.

options.text: He asked that where is the library.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the question is not converted to a statement.

questions.explanation: In indirect speech, questions change to statements with subject-verb order. “Where is” becomes “where was.”
questions.subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: She said, “I will go to Delhi tomorrow.” Which is the correct indirect speech?

options.text: She said that she would go to Delhi the next day.
options.explanation: Correct because 'will go' changes to 'would go' and 'tomorrow' changes to 'the next day'.

options.text: She said that she will go to Delhi tomorrow.

options.text: She said that she would go to Delhi tomorrow.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'tomorrow' should change to 'the next day'.

options.text: She said that I will go to Delhi the next day.
options.explanation: Incorrect because 'I' should change to 'she'.

questions.explanation: The future tense “will go” changes to “would go,” and “tomorrow” changes to “the next day.”
questions.subject: upbo5-english

questions.question: Mohan said, “I can swim very well.” In indirect speech, this becomes:

questions.question: The child said, “I want an ice cream.” Choose the correct indirect speech:
